title: Cloud service models
body: In which model does the provider manage the runtime and OS while you deploy only your application code?

options.e: With SaaS you use a finished application.

explanation: IaaS gives VMs and networks you manage; PaaS (e.g. Azure App Service) runs your code; SaaS delivers complete software.

title: Autoscaling

options.t: Increases VM size during the night
Adds or removes instances automatically based on metrics such as CPU, memory or queue length

explanation: Services must be stateless and start quickly; set min/max limits and cool-down periods.

title: Availability zones
body: Why deploy instances across multiple availability zones?

options.t: To reduce latency to all users worldwide
To survive the failure of a single data centre within a region

explanation: Use multiple regions for disaster recovery or global latency; multi-AZ protects against data-centre outages.

title: Object storage
body: Which workload is object storage (S3, Azure Blob) best suited for?

options.t: Storing large amounts of unstructured files such as images, backups and logs

explanation: Serve user uploads via pre-signed URLs or a CDN instead of streaming them through the API.
